purpose: 用固定像素合同批量生产几十种主题的战场地面方格：一格一张、自带格边框、另有前立面提供厚度。当前版本不做材质过渡件。

topology.rotation_policy: directional pieces are authored per direction; runtime rotation is forbidden for any piece with light, facade, wear or shadow direction
topology.assembly_rule: exactly one self-contained 32x32 square per gameplay cell, placed and swapped by the map editor; a front face may be attached to any cell's south edge for a height step and is drawn after the next row's ground; a board edge row replaces the outer square with the matching 32x40 directional piece, whose 32x32 walkable part aligns to the grid and whose 8 px facade overhangs outside the board without changing the logical or hit footprint; no board-wide baked texture and no cross-cell continuation

locked_invariants.footprint: the full 32x32 square canvas is exactly one walkable gameplay cell
locked_invariants.perimeter: 每一块地面自带明显格边框：1 原生像素、本材质自身暗色（不得纯黑）、四边一致、相邻拼接重合为一条缝；边框内侧 1px 受光唇线读作高度。当前版本不做材质过渡件，格边框是唯一的格子分隔手段（此处取代早期“不给每格烘焙边框”的规定）
locked_invariants.depth: 立体感由独立 32x8 前立面提供：贴所属格南侧外沿、向下越出 8px、覆盖下一行格顶面，按行由远及近绘制；可按格选用，不占逻辑格与点击区
locked_invariants.illumination: 资产不含任何场景光照：不烘焙光斑、地面投影、暗角或边缘变暗；场景光与影全部由运行时 URP 2D Light2D 负责
locked_invariants.form_shading: 资产只保留体积明暗：固定的左上方向一处，顶面亮、正面暗，用来让实体读成立体；这是形状语言而不是光照，且每个主题每块都一致
locked_invariants.value_hierarchy: center surface low contrast; border and collision silhouette readable; gameplay overlays remain highest contrast
locked_invariants.density: 近平面：主色占比不少于 45%，铺装主题目标 75–90%；最多三处相连的深色团块；禁止高频抖色与孤立噪点（已通过的庭院石基准：2–4 色、主色 75–88%、0 孤立像素）
locked_invariants.palette: neutral material base first; cyan only for active aether; rust red only for hostile or damage semantics; safety yellow only for service, warning or loot
locked_invariants.single_native_source: one 32 PPU native asset per piece, displayed at integer tiers only, canonical 6x at 1920x1080 (6 screen px per native px); no separate resolution companion
locked_invariants.uniform_pixel_size: ground tiles, directional edges, props, structures and units must all render at the same screen pixels per native pixel in one battle view; a 16 px ground tile therefore occupies 96 screen units while a 32 px prop or unit occupies 192
locked_invariants.directional_edge_identity: the top 16x16 is the approved theme surface copied exactly; only the exterior facade overhang is independently generated and normalized, preventing a material jump on the boundary row
locked_invariants.ground_window_normalization: an opaque ground-material source may decode to a larger stable logical field; the deterministic centered 32x32 window, or a recorded phase-aligned window origin when needed to avoid clipping a regular slab rhythm, is the formal surface delivery. **The decoded design field must be within 1.4x of the window in each axis** — a window that crops a much larger, finer-grained design yields a fragment of a bigger picture instead of one whole square, and is rejected instead of delivered (this is the recorded failure mode of the 16 px trial). It records logical bounds and source hash and may neither resize, interpolate, paint, add colours nor alter any selected logical pixel. For a regular repeating brick/material field whose repetition makes the generic non-repeating-subject confidence ambiguous, a reviewer may declare the observed square macro-pixel pitch; this path remains REVIEW_READY and requires explicit human pixel-scale, material and application approval before FORMAL_CANDIDATE
locked_invariants.grid_layer: a shared 1-native-pixel tactical-grid overlay may still be drawn on top at every integer tier, but it is no longer required to define cells: the tile carries its own visible border

prompt_contract.prefix: single isolated battlefield floor square for a near-modern aether-industrial tactical map; orthographic top-down; exactly one 32 by 32 cell, complete and self-contained
required: the whole tile is one square cell with a clearly visible 1-pixel border on all four edges in the material's own dark tone, never black
a 1-pixel lighter lip just inside the border so the square reads as raised
near-flat field: one dominant tone covering most of the square, at most three connected darker clusters (approved paving baseline: 2 colours, dominant 88 percent, zero isolated pixels)
flat even illumination with no directional scene light, no cast shadow and no edge darkening
fixed upper-left form shading on raised material only

production_gates.name: theme_lock
production_gates.rule: freeze theme parameters and one reference square before batch generation

production_gates.name: source
production_gates.rule: one independent image-model generation per formal square or front face; directional-edge delivery composes the approved square top with the independently generated facade overhang and records both component sources and hashes

production_gates.name: normalize
production_gates.rule: decode the material lattice without geometric resizing; a stable opaque field may yield its recorded centered 32x32 logical window without changing selected pixels, and the decoded field must stay within 1.4x of the window in each axis; deliver squares at 32x32 and front faces at 32x8; directional outer edges at 32x40 with an 8 px facade overhang; hard alpha, limited palette, Point/Clamp/Full Rect

production_gates.name: batch_contact
production_gates.rule: review 1x, 6x, grayscale, checker, a square-plus-front-face contact and a randomized 12x9 assembly contact before Unity

production_gates.name: human_style
production_gates.rule: reject the whole theme batch if the reference square breaks the border, flatness, illumination, form-shading or value invariants

production_gates.name: runtime_contact
production_gates.rule: verify 1920x1080 at the canonical 6x tier using the same native asset with an integer scale only, and run Tools/OCCArt/verify_runtime_pixel_grid.py on the capture: the detected lattice must be the expected integer tier with zero offset, and ground, front faces, props, structures and units must share one pixel size; no board texture

production_gates.name: promotion
production_gates.rule: only after stable GUID, verified importer (Point / Full Rect / no compression / no mipmaps), lattice check and runtime evidence may a piece become FORMAL

rework_policy.regenerate_scope: regenerate only the rejected piece unless it violates a locked theme invariant; invariant failure invalidates the full theme batch
never: do not generate a full board as a production source
do not rotate directional pieces at runtime
do not create a new border grammar per theme
do not use palette reduction to hide noisy structure
do not resize, interpolate, repaint or synthesize the selected ground window
do not bake scene lighting or shadow into any piece
do not deliver a cropped fragment of a larger floor design as one square
do not omit or blacken the cell border
